basis: The footprint is the mapped reserve hangar. Pomerleau gives the long clear span, aircraft clearance, three raked corrugated walls, a 15 m raked curtain wall, the metal-covered rounded roof and two aircraft doors. Original Qualla aerial imagery confirms the pale finish and airport orientation.
estimates: The model assigns glazing to the museum-facing long elevation, sliding doors to the opposite runway-facing elevation, and estimates the roof crown, end profile, and individual panel widths. The reported curtain inclination is represented by the slope of the glazing plane from its foundation to the spring of the roof.
